grounding_note: 5 of 5 quoted claims were verified against the source text.

claims.claim: NovaCare AI describes its product only as an AI platform for healthcare.
The deck positions the company broadly as the future of healthcare, without a segment.
The market opportunity is asserted but not quantified or defined.
The team is described in general terms with no named domain experience.
The deck identifies no target customer, buyer or workflow.
The deck names no competitors, incumbents or alternative approaches.
The deck presents no traction such as users, pilots or revenue.
